dedupe_keys.name: おおいたマイ タイムライン等 防災行動計画 fire police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: おおいたマイ・タイムライン等(防災行動計画) [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分県. タイムライン（＝災害時の行動を時系列に整理した「防災行動計画」）は、災害に対する事前の備えや、大雨・台風により浸水害や洪水、土砂災害などが発生する危険性が高まった時の避難開始のタイミング、「避難スイッチ」などを、あらかじめ時系列に整理した【自分自身や家族、地域の防災行動計画】です。 個人・家族向け：おおいたマイ・タイムライン、要配慮者向け... Coverage: 大分県. The portal files it under the publisher 大分県. Its tags are 防災. It offers 4 resource(s) in pptx, xlsx. The portal shows 2023-04-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
